title: 水庫異重流排砂
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways
summary: 本課以以密度差潛入沉降與底孔捕捉解析異重流為主線，先用懸浮濃度與混合密度與約化重力與浮力界定水力與構造條件，再將沉降時間與粒徑、底孔捕捉與排出連結到底流質量帳與殘留。均勻兩層與稀懸浮算例只呈現尺度，實際異重流受分層地形紊混與粒徑演變控制。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops analyzing density currents through plunging settling and low-outlet capture through Suspension concentration and mixture density and Reduced gravity and buoyancy, then connects Settling time and particle size and Low-outlet capture and export to Current mass budget and residual storage. Uniform two-layer dilute-suspension examples illustrate scales; real currents depend on stratification topography mixing and grain-size evolution. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸浮濃度與混合密度」與「約化重力與浮力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Suspension concentration and mixture density" and "Reduced gravity and buoyancy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Suspension concentration and mixture density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「懸浮濃度與混合密度」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suspension concentration and mixture density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。體積濃度不同於每立方公尺混合水的乾砂質量濃度，換算須使用顆粒密度；判斷下潛前應同步量測清水背景與含砂水。 驗證時應同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「懸浮濃度與混合密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density. Volume fraction differs from dry sediment mass per mixture volume and requires grain density for conversion. Measure both ambient and incoming water before inferring plunging behavior. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Suspension concentration and mixture density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「懸浮濃度與混合密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Suspension concentration and mixture density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度
knowledge.text: 含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。體積濃度不同於每立方公尺混合水的乾砂質量濃度，換算須使用顆粒密度；判斷下潛前應同步量測清水背景與含砂水。
knowledge.textEn: Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density. Volume fraction differs from dry sediment mass per mixture volume and requires grain density for conversion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸浮濃度與混合密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Suspension concentration and mixture density" is correct?
options: 只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重
含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。
約化重力是一旦決定就不會沿程改變的常數
optionsEn: Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water
Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density.
Reduced gravity cannot change along the current once initially specified
quiz.explanation: 含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Suspension concentration and mixture density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「懸浮濃度與混合密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Suspension concentration and mixture density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Suspension concentration and mixture density: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「懸浮濃度與混合密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Suspension concentration and mixture density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「懸浮濃度與混合密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Suspension concentration and mixture density"?
options: 同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
所有排砂效率百分比不需看分母就可互相比較
optionsEn: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Every venting-efficiency percentage is comparable without inspecting its denominator
quiz.explanation: 同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Suspension concentration and mixture density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「懸浮濃度與混合密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Suspension concentration and mixture density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Diagnose it by the following check: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「懸浮濃度與混合密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Suspension concentration and mixture density" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向。

Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks.

quiz.explanation: 忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 約化重力與浮力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reduced gravity and buoyancy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「約化重力與浮力」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reduced gravity and buoyancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 約化重力以密度差相對背景密度縮放重力，表達異重流的浮力驅動尺度。分母選用哪個參考密度須一致，小密度差近似不能任意延伸至高濃度泥流；密度差沿程因捲吸與沉降變化，因此不是固定材料常數。 驗證時應沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差，並辨識以下失效情境：把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「約化重力與浮力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reduced gravity scales gravitational acceleration by relative density excess. Use a consistent reference density and do not extend a small-density-difference approximation to dense debris flows. Entrainment and settling change the excess along the route, so reduced gravity is a changing flow property rather than a material constant. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reduced gravity and buoyancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「約化重力是一旦決定就不會沿程改變的常數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced gravity cannot change along the current once initially specified" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「約化重力與浮力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reduced gravity and buoyancy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 約化重力與浮力

knowledge.textEn: Reduced gravity scales gravitational acceleration by relative density excess. Use a consistent reference density and do not extend a small-density-difference approximation to dense debris flows.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：約化重力是一旦決定就不會沿程改變的常數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

Density-current thickness always equals total reservoir depth
Reduced gravity scales gravitational acceleration by relative density excess.

steps.title: 約化重力與浮力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reduced gravity and buoyancy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「約化重力與浮力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reduced gravity and buoyancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 約化重力與浮力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reduced gravity and buoyancy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「約化重力與浮力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reduced gravity and buoyancy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.text: 交接時以沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

quiz.question: 要驗證「約化重力與浮力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam.
An acceptable mixed oxygen average means every downstream location is identical

steps.title: 約化重力與浮力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reduced gravity and buoyancy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「約化重力與浮力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reduced gravity and buoyancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「約化重力是一旦決定就不會沿程改變的常數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced gravity cannot change along the current once initially specified" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「約化重力與浮力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reduced gravity and buoyancy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
異重流厚度一定等於整個水庫的水深
把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Density-current thickness always equals total reservoir depth
Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution.
quiz.explanation: 把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
